author: response_packet_audit

geometry_reference.projection: historical SIN solid-angle, orthographic parallel-ray planar deprojection; not full tilted-ring perspective
geometry_reference.distance_reference_codes: THINGS K04 and Leroy table4; reconcile proposed Jacobs/TRGB likelihood

roles.RO: correlated imaging control; not independent replicate or error bar

gas_selectors.order_selection: unique /maps/{map}/orders entry with subpixels_per_axis==8; current array index1, verify predicate rather than trust index
gas_selectors.selection: consecutive complete_by_conservative_chord_bound=true prefix; require groups/full/usable_complete_annulus true and finite nonnegative signed mass in every selected bin; refuse negative net bin, do not clip

fields.groups/full/mass_Msun: bare retained HI bin mass, Msun; NO helium yet
fields.groups/full/effective_retained_HI_Msun_p: bare HI mass / full nominal disk annulus area, Msun/pc^2
fields.groups/full/nominal_disk_area_pc2: full nominal disk annulus area, pc^2; not measured footprint
fields.groups/full/nonfinite_sky_sr: nonfinite area ledger; require zero selected
fields.groups/full/plane_pc2: sampled planar footprint, not denominator substitute

gas_selectors.bins_are: annuli, not pointwise samples or values at bin centres
gas_selectors.boundary_ledger: retain all bins beyond prefix and complete_prefix excluded_retained_HI_Msun/excluded_absolute_retained_HI_Msun; no physical zero exterior
gas_selectors.assignment_control: orders with subpixels_per_axis==4 and assignment_signed_8minus4_Msun are numerical controls, not observational covariance

conversions.raw_release: original THINGS MOM0; not LITTLE THINGS X0_P_R
conversions.channel_width: already integrated; do not multiply again
conversions.helium_application: multiply bare mass_Msun exactly once during gas reconstruction; do not also multiply mass_HI_plus_He_Msun
conversions.zeros: REMAG blank replacement; not measured gas absence

distance_scaling.gas_masses: mass, positive/negative mass and exterior retained mass multiply lambda^2
distance_scaling.areas: nominal_disk_area_pc2 and sampled plane_pc2 multiply lambda^2
distance_scaling.surface_density: same angular-bin mass/area unchanged under distance-only scaling
distance_scaling.stellar_radii: multiply lambda at fixed original angular profile
distance_scaling.stellar_surface_density: unchanged if same luminosity-to-mass convention and angular geometry; stellar mass then scales lambda^2
distance_scaling.stellar_tail: historical .8kpc reference length scales lambda ONLY when retaining its fixed angular-shape convention; this is not an independently measured physical tail length
distance_scaling.geometry_changes: inclination/PA/centre/warp changes require a separately qualified deprojection from existing raw map; not represented by distance-only scaling or a global cosine correction

radial_reconstruction.gas: reuse algorithm as formula; do not import historical modules
formula: s_0=mean_0; s_i=min(mean_(i-1),mean_i) for interior edges; s_n=0
radial_reconstruction.scope: C0 nonnegative mass-conserving chosen interpolation; interpolation/axisymmetry uncertainty remains unmeasured
radial_reconstruction.outside_aperture: retained-signal contrast zero only; actual exterior component is separate null input

stars.stellar_scatter_interpretation: not a full covariance or population-systematic interval
stars.interpolation: constant to first radius; linear in R between supplied rings; historical exponential continuation with .8kpc reference scale beyond1.4kpc; not empirically admitted outer-tail law
stars.HI_column: do not add Leroy HI+He on top of THINGS HI+He
stars.H2: blank fields/omitted historical component are not zero-density measurements; physical interval null

volume_and_FE_interface.formula: rho_c(R,z)=Sigma_c(R)*f_c(z|R), f_c>=0 and integral_over_full_z f_c dz=1; f units inverse length
volume_and_FE_interface.units_conversion: convert Sigma Msun/pc^2 to SI kg/m^2 and f to m^-1 before rho SI; constants and their unit version must be pinned in implementing producer
volume_and_FE_interface.normalization_if_truncated: integral over finite vertical domain may be below1; retain exterior mass rather than renormalize silently
volume_and_FE_interface.dimensionless_source: s_hat=4pi G rho_SI L0/A0; require admitted G,L0,A0 and consistent units
volume_and_FE_interface.source_load: load_i=integral Rhat dRhat dzhat N_i*s_hat; add PLUS load dot Phi to reduced energy; drop common2pi from all meridional variational terms consistently
volume_and_FE_interface.full_mass_check: physical mass=2pi integral R rho dR dz; common2pi absence from solve does not remove it from physical mass
volume_and_FE_interface.Q1_adapter: evaluate admitted nonnegative volume source at common positive quadrature; unresolved radial knots/vertical scale require quadrature/refinement error ownership; do not identify annular masses with nodal point densities
volume_and_FE_interface.thin_disk: a delta(z) sheet needs a separate weak interface; do not feed infinite/zero-thickness volume density into existing Q1 volume verifier
volume_and_FE_interface.caution: existing geometric verifier supports fixed Phi,b lifts and homogeneous adjoint xi only; independent physical xi exterior is not implemented

refusal_rules: nonfinite or negative net selected annulus
volume evaluation requested with null vertical family
physical prediction requested with missing source/state/exterior/read errors
import_safety: Do NOT import ddo154_density.py, galaxy_density.py or halogas_density.py: historical import chain loads another galaxy input at module import. Reimplement isolated source-only formulas after review; no import occurred here.
exposure: Only authorized ordinary-source JSON and DDO stellar-source rows interpreted. A mixed Leroy catalogue DDO row was displayed for distance/reference verification; other columns were not used or adopted. No rotation table, cube/moment1, fitted response or NGC3198 velocity arrays opened.
not_ready_for_physical_volume_solve: Surface-source reference is specified; vertical family, physical uncertainty and exterior are still null. Specification is not a numerical producer or physical admission.
